title: Cost Estimating
desc: Parametric, order-of-magnitude, preconstruction, GMP, and change order estimating across all trades for a wide range of sectors. Services include owner's representative cost consultancy, bid leveling, lease term analysis, procurement support, and pricing of construction claims. Trade fluency in Architectural · MEP · Hazardous Removals · Vertical Transportation · Heavy Civil · Utilities

title: Change Management
desc: Change entitlement analysis, scope definition, and reconciliation of contractor proposals against independent cost estimates prepared on behalf of agencies. Negotiate with contractors to a fair and reasonable resolution for added and deleted scope. Technical letter writing for defending independent cost estimates and recommendations to the client..

title: Procurement
desc: Long-lead equipment tracking, A/E fee analysis, bid leveling, and vendor negotiation. Procurement schedules built backwards from installation milestones to protect schedule. Review of subcontract-related invoices and ensures that invoices are approved in accordance with terms and conditions agreed within the subcontract.

title: Project Controls
desc: Estimating, claims resolution, cost management, and scheduling competencies applied to measure project performance against forecast and to identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Experience includes reviewing contractor baseline schedules, validating monthly progress, maintaining independent cost reports against the capital plan, forecasting EAC, tracking contingency drawdown, auditing certified payroll, and processing change orders and contractor payments.
